chk_events_channel_fallback_reason.name: chk_events_channel_fallback_reason
chk_events_channel_fallback_reason.value: "events"."requested_channel" IS NULL OR "events"."selected_channel" IS NULL OR ("events"."requested_channel" = "events"."selected_channel" AND "events"."fallback_reason" IS NULL) OR ("events"."requested_channel" <> "events"."selected_channel" AND "events"."fallback_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("events"."fallback_reason")) > 0)

chk_keyword_commands_reserved_wording_on.name: chk_keyword_commands_reserved_wording_only
chk_keyword_commands_reserved_wording_on.value: "keyword_commands"."keyword" NOT IN ('STOP', 'START', 'HELP', 'YES', 'NO') OR ("keyword_commands"."action" = 'reply' AND "keyword_commands"."workflow_id" IS NULL)

chk_keyword_commands_reply_text.name: chk_keyword_commands_reply_text
chk_keyword_commands_reply_text.value: NOT "keyword_commands"."enabled" OR "keyword_commands"."action" <> 'reply' OR "keyword_commands"."response_text" IS NOT NULL
